activities.title: Settebello Pizzeria Napoletana
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 1, MSP Mall

Authentic Napoletana pizza right in the airport. Enjoy wood-fired pizzas with fresh ingredients, salads, charcuterie, and a full bar before boarding your flight. Also has vegantaian options.
